title: Mako's shape with both card close days "not sure": one with a typed last statement, one without (decision H4, review v3 situation 5, E10)
story: Mako's shape: one main bank, pay on the 10th (main job 250,000 and side job 50,000), rent on the 27th, a trip goal kept in the bank, two cards paid in full from the bank on the 10th and 11th. He does not know either card's close day (the setup default, A8). Card A: he typed the last statement at setup (60,000, closed 15 Nov, not paid yet); 75,000 is owed now. Card B: no statement typed; 30,000 is owed now. H4: on each payment day everything owed, less payments since, is due. Set up Fri 20 Nov 2026. January 2027: pay lands Fri the 8th; the 11th is a holiday, so both cards are taken Tue 12 Jan. He does not record the January card payments. Every amount is made up.
